title: Metamorphosis Open Context
description: Arguments captured at the start of a metamorphosis — just before the next being is instantiated.

fromClass.description: Fully-qualified class name of the being being transformed from.

beAttribute.description: Stringified #[Be(...)] attribute declaring the next destination.

immanentSources.description: Map of #[Input] parameter names to their origin path on the previous being.

transcendentSources.description: Map of #[Inject] parameter names to the interface / service identifier resolved from the DI container.
